items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I'd see Dizzy and hear Monk... Monk was making these sounds? Yeah, both Monk and Dizzy would be playing.

ctx.x: Well, I think one thing you haven't said, though, we've jumped over... When we were at 63rd Street, you knew all those people like Benny Carter and Russell Procope.
Oh yeah! And then, Mr. Samuels, Mr. Monk -- they were all there. They were all there! Yes.
